name: Love Cafe ~Doutei na Ore demo, Kyonyuu Onna Senpai to Dousei Dekirutte Maji Desu ka?
original_name: ラブカフェ～童貞な俺でも、巨乳女先輩と同棲できるってマジですか？
source:
That day, the protagonist, Takimura Hiroshi, hung his head and felt dejected on a bench at the park in the evening.
A place to live... gone.

According to his apartment's contract, in case that the rent couldn't be withdrawal​ from his account, he would have to leave immediately. As a result, his luggage was taken outside, and the lock for the front door was changed to another one. According to the realtor, if he was there at the time his luggage was taken out, it could have been different.

Job hunting failed, and no place to live as well... What will happen from now on?

"If that's the case, then why don't you come to our house?"

While thinking and sighing for a while, a voice called out to him. The three women told him that they live together nearby, and after hearing about his depressed situation, the women invited him.
Instead of receiving rent, they want him to do household chores and, maybe, give him a few shifts as a part-time job.

Takimura bowed his head and gladly accepted their offer. Thus begins the domestic life of 4 people.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://evoll.jp/product/lovecafe/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
那天傍晚，主人公泷村博史垂头丧气地坐在公园长椅上。

住处……没了。

根据公寓租约，如果房租无法从他的账户扣款，他就得立刻搬走。结果他的行李被搬到了屋外，门锁也换了。房产中介说，如果当时他在场，情况或许会不一样。

找工作失败了，住处也没了……他今后该怎么办？

“既然这样，要不要来我们家住？”

他思索叹息了一阵，一个声音向他搭话。3名住在附近的女性听说他的窘境后，邀请他到家中同住。

他不用付房租，只需帮忙做家务；或许她们还能给他安排几班兼职。

泷村低头致谢，欣然接受了邀请。4人同居的生活就此开始。

[译自并改编自[url=https://evoll.jp/product/lovecafe/index.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
